conventions.axes: Y-up, right-handed; camera looks down -Z by default; ground is the XZ plane at y = 0
conventions.lightIntensity: three.js physical units (directional/hemisphere/ambient: lux-like; spot/point: candela, decay 2)
conventions.easing: named functions from kit/time.js `ease` (formulas in references/kit-api.md)
conventions.camera: fov is vertical field of view in degrees (three.js convention); sensor-agnostic

style.name: Blueprint Build
style.description: A cyanotype drafting sheet come to life: deep Prussian-blue paper with a faint grid, fibres and fold creases; objects drawn as crisp pale hidden-line linework (visible edges solid, hidden edges dashed) that plots on stroke by stroke, with dash-dot centre-lines, dimensions, leaders, hatching and a title block in single-stroke technical lettering. Front elevation tilts into an isometric view.

ink.description: line/arrowhead colour; blended with MAX (lighten) so overlaps never double

motion: Lines plot on along their length in drafting order: construction lines, then outlines, then dimensions, then lettering.
One pen at a time: a small amber plotter-head crosshair rides the tip of whatever is being drawn.
Parts slide apart along their dash-dot axis lines (exploded view) with an inOutCubic ease and a soft clack at rest.
Camera: orthographic-like long lens (9° fov); holds a flat front elevation, then one slow tilt to isometric; never cuts.
Annotation lives on the sheet (screen space): leaders re-attach to their 3D anchors as the view tilts.

objects.procedural: full-frame cyanotype paper: Prussian-blue wash with fbm mottling, fibres, two fold creases, vignette, per-pixel grain; 27 px drafting grid (major every 135 px) that fades in
MODEL core: lathe-turned chamfered cylinder Ø2.0 x 1.28 m with a groove band and a Ø1.12 boss, drawn as hidden-line edges (feature creases > 24°, view-dependent silhouettes)
three TOOL modules 1.0 x 0.72 x 0.72 m chamfered boxes at r = 2.55 m (left, right, back), each on a Ø0.18 connector shaft, top-face icons
MEMORY stack: three chamfered drums Ø1.64 x 0.26 m on a Ø0.32 shaft under the core; explodes along the vertical centre-line
loop arrow: R 3.3 m ring at y = 0.2 sweeping 310° with a filled arrowhead; hidden stretches dashed

scene.notes: Assembly geometry, plot windows and sheet layout are data here; scene.js builds them with blueprint-build props and drives progress from PLOT.
